checklist: RAW 9 (§8) on the first ARWs of LUMINA_EDIT_DIR: the decoder map per body (supported versions, raw 9 present, fastest), time-to-first-tile and time-to-full-region for a 1024×768-class loupe region at 100 % (targets: first tile ≤ 250 ms, full ≤ 1.2 s on the dev Mac; the M1 numbers are recorded via probe_remote.sh), export time and phys_footprint per file for the older version vs the newest, the per-file fallback forced with a version this Mac lacks, and region tiles vs the export graph at the same region for every decoder version present (ΔE median ≤ 0.5). The loupe through the page's plumbing (lumina.edit.loupe) is also driven on the native canvas so the facts line shows `raw N · region`. RAW 9 itself needs macOS 27: elsewhere this measures raw 8 (and 7) the same way.
